picks.title: US Copyright Office starts to question authors about potentially AI-generated work
picks.excerpt: Humans are checking every manuscript and, in some instances, the Copyright Office sends a follow-up email asking the author to clarify their use of AI.
picks.rationale: A concrete procedural change: the US Copyright Office is checking manuscripts by hand and emailing authors to clarify their AI use, which changes how authors file registrations.

picks.title: “AI 때문에 내 책 안 팔리면 저작권 침해?”…美 연구진 반론
picks.excerpt: UC버클리 파멜라 새뮤얼슨 교수 연구진이 사이언스에 낸 논문에서, AI가 인간 작가의 책 시장을 잠식한다는 '시장 희석' 이론은 실제 피해 입증이 어렵고 저작권 원칙과 충돌한다며 소송보다 입법으로 풀어야 한다고 지적했다.
picks.rationale: A new Science paper by Pamela Samuelson's team challenges the 'market dilution' theory at the centre of the authors' AI copyright suits, and argues that legislation, not litigation, should settle it.

picks.title: Introducing Worldbuilding Images
picks.excerpt: Sudowrite adds Worldbuilding Images, generating AI visuals for locations, objects and other Story Bible worldbuilding elements, following last week's Character Portraits for novelists' casts.
picks.rationale: A new product release in a novelist's tool: Story Bible can now generate images of locations and objects, not just characters, so writers can do visual worldbuilding without leaving the tool.

picks.title: 웹툰·웹소설을 AI 애니로…카카오픽코마 '탈웹툰' 승부수
picks.excerpt: 카카오픽코마가 웹툰·웹소설 원작을 AI 애니메이션으로 제작하는 '탈웹툰' 전략에 나섰다. AI로 영상화 비용과 기간을 줄여 IP를 확장하려는 시도.
picks.rationale: A new company strategy: Kakao Piccoma will use AI to turn webtoon and web-novel IP into animation, cutting the cost and time of adaptation.

picks.title: Culture Minister Pledges AI Support for Webtoon Creators
picks.excerpt: South Korea's culture ministry pledged AI support for webtoon creators, with 32.7 billion won allocated in the 2027 budget proposal.
picks.rationale: A concrete government commitment: 32.7 billion won in Korea's 2027 budget proposal for AI support to webtoon creators.

alternates.title: Frankfurter Buchmesse 2026: Programs Explore AI's Impact on Translation, and the Future of Publishing
alternates.excerpt: With AI a major topic of conversation at this year's fair, research presented in Czechia's Frankfurt pavilion examined how publishing professionals use AI—and why literary translators remain concerned about their livelihoods.
alternates.rationale: First backup if a pick is swapped. It belongs to the saturated Frankfurt and translation thread (ENLIT 10-11, Nippon 10-15) and was passed over on 10-17.

https://feedback.sudowrite.com/changelog.new_action: New feature release: Worldbuilding Images, which generates images for Story Bible locations, objects and worldbuilding elements. It is a separate launch from the Character Portraits feature published 09-28.
